mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an active monetary easing policy, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation and compresses the risk premium, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.0% signals a deep recession phase where the Federal Reserve is likely to implement aggressive monetary stimulus, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as market expectations shift toward recovery.
failure_condition: In instances where UNRATE > 9.0%, 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-recession recovery phase, a sustained increase in housing starts signals strengthening residential construction and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the economy transitions to growth.
failure_condition: In the post-recession recovery regime, 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) both rise simultaneously, it signals a broad-based economic recovery across the housing sector and manufacturing, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as market sentiment shifts toward sustained growth.
failure_condition: When both HOUST and INDPRO rise, 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate falls below 0.2%, it signals the Federal Reserve has entered a near-zero interest rate policy, which stimulates equity valuations through lower discount rates and increased liquidity, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.2%, 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal a strengthening labor market and robust consumer spending, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings growth is reinforced.
failure_condition: When both PAYEMS and RSAFS rise, 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases, or the interaction term in a regression model is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In the post-recession recovery phase, a sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals strengthening manufacturing output and supply chain normalization, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate profits improve.
failure_condition: In the post-recession recovery regime, 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in non-farm payrolls consistently signals a strengthening labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03, or 5-day forward returns in the presence of rising payrolls are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
